I was fortunate enough to be close by and not get shutdown due to in-climate weather as a bunch of my friends did. The shot was fairly easy to take. court.desc: Court of Final Appeal Building is a tourist spot. It's the former High Court and Legislative Council building during colonial rule period. It's a 'declared monument' in Hong Kong. It's occupied by Japanese invaders during World War 2 and was the headquarter of the Japanese army's Commander in Chief (香港日治時期之日軍憲兵總部）. Hong Kong was occupied by Japanese invaders for 3 years and 8 months during World War II. The architectural style was Neo-classical. Construction began on 1900 and completed in 1912.
